svg.title: Store agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore: sign-in, allowed and denied tool calls
svg.desc: A store lead signs in to Amazon Cognito and sends a prompt with the access token to the AgentCore Runtime in a private VPC. The agent calls Nova Lite on Amazon Bedrock through a guardrail and keeps the session in AgentCore Memory. It calls tools over MCP through AgentCore Gateway with the same token; AgentCore Policy evaluates Cedar policies on every call, permits get_order, which a Lambda tool serves from DynamoDB, and denies an injected USD 500 refund, so no return is opened.

g.text: Runtime, gateway, policy and tools, all in Terraform
A store lead signs in · the prompt carries their token
Each tool call is authorized as that person: allowed
An injected USD 500 refund is denied at the gateway
